prompt: A cinematic film still captures a tense moment in a sterile hospital corridor. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits slumped on a plastic chair, her head bowed low in exhaustion. Beside her stands a tall nurse in crisp blue scrubs, leaning forward with a concerned expression while holding a silver clipboard tightly against her chest. In the center of the frame, a young boy in a striped shirt points urgently toward the double doors at the far end of the hall, his face pale and eyes wide with fear. Next to him, a golden retriever sits calmly, its leash held loosely by the boy’s other hand, providing a stark contrast to the tension. To the right, a doctor in a white coat looks intently at a glowing tablet screen, ignoring the commotion around him. A red fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall near the doctor, standing out against the beige paint. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene. The nurse is handing a tissue to the elderly woman, who reaches out with a trembling hand to accept it. The doctor is looking at the tablet, completely absorbed in the data displayed. The boy is pointing at the doors, directing attention away from the immediate group. The golden retriever is sitting next to the boy, offering silent support. The elderly woman is sitting on the chair, embodying fatigue. The nurse is standing beside the woman, showing care. The doctor is positioned on the right, isolated by his focus. The boy is in the center, acting as the focal point of action. The fire extinguisher is on the right wall, a static element.
